# Welcome to Sample Project

This is a test documentation project.

!!! note "Getting Started"
    Make sure you have Python 3.10+ installed.

??? tip "Optional Configuration"
    You can customize settings in your configuration file.

=== "Sync API"
    ```python
    import sample
    sample.run()
    ```

=== "Async API"
    ```python
    import sample
    await sample.async_run()
    ```

See our [API Documentation](api.md) for more details.
